spans.s:
मैत्र a. (त्री f.) [मित्र-अण्]
1
Belonging to a friend.
--2 Given by
a friend.
--3 Friendly,
well-disposed, amicable, kind;

.
--त्रः
1 A high or
perfect Brāhmaṇa.
--2 N. of a
particular mixed tribe;

.
--3 The anus.
--4 A friend.
--त्री
1
Friendship, good will.
--2
Intimate connection or association,
union, contact; प्रत्यूषेषु
स्फुटितकतलामोदमैत्रीकषायः
Me. 31

.
--3 The
lupar mansion called अनुराधा.
--त्रं
1
Friendship.
--2 Voiding or
evacuation of excrement;

.
--3 A prayer addressed to Mitra.
--4
The lunar mansion अनुराधा (मैत्रभं) in
the same sense.
मैत्रकं Friendship.

1 An epithet of
Vālmīki.
--2 Of Agastya.
--3 N. of one
of the officiating priests at a
sacrifice.
--4 N. of Vasiṣṭha;

1 An epithet of
Agastya.
--2 Of Vasiṣṭha.
--3 Of
Vālmīki.
मैत्रिन् a. Friendly, kind.

मैत्रेय a. (यी f.) Relating to a
friend, friendly.
--यः N. of a
mixed tribe.
मैत्रेयकः N. of a mixed tribe;

मैत्रेयिका A contest between friends
or allies (मित्रयुद्धं).
मैत्र्यं Friendship, alliance.
